readerCopy.body: You can keep explaining the same thing and still avoid changing what the conversation is about. Mercury square the South Node can turn an old argument, assumption, or communication habit into the obvious source of friction. You may over-explain, repeat the history, answer the point nobody made, or keep checking for a response that will not settle the issue. The problem may not need better wording. It may need you to stop using the same mental route every time you reach the same uncomfortable conclusion.
